text: Welcome.
This is a few quiet minutes in the middle of your day, just for you.
Toward the end, I'll give you a few words to say to yourself.
Allow yourself to take this time to put things down for now.
You can close your eyes, or let them rest softly on one spot.
Take one slow breath in.
And let it go.
Bring a little softness to your jaw. Let it loosen.
Allow your shoulders to relax.
Let your hands rest wherever they are comfortable.
Soften the space around your eyes.
With each breath, a little more ease.
Whatever comes next can wait a few minutes.
There is time. You have time.
Let your breath move at its own gentle pace.
Let each out-breath be a little longer than the in-breath.
Now say this to yourself, silently.
I have time.
I have enough.
One more slow breath.
You're here. You're present.
When you're ready, let your eyes open, and take this steadiness with you.
